arguments.summary: The failed-jobs backlog in the jobs database has been growing due to issues with service pgbouncer and the read replica being 12 minutes behind the primary. The read replica was used to export the failed_jobs table for the postmortem, and the primary was queried to get current failed-job counts. The next steps will involve investigating the root cause of the failed jobs and addressing the backlog.
arguments.recommended_next_step: Investigate the root cause of the failed jobs, address the backlog, and ensure the read replica is synchronized with the primary.
